title: Find Index of Element
description:
Write a function `find_index_of(items, target)` that returns the zero-based index of the first occurrence of `target` in `items`.
If `target` is not found, return `-1`.
Do not use the built-in `.index()` method.

hidden_tests.kind: target at the very last index

hints: Linear searching examines each element along with its numeric position.
Make sure you track index from 0 rather than 1, and only return once a match is confirmed.
If your loop completes without finding a match, the fallback return must be -1.
Use enumerate(items) to check each index and item pair, returning the index on match and -1 after the loop.
